description: Hand-picked personal examples that show the sarcasm cues this project studies. Labels: 1 = sarcastic, 0 = not sarcastic.

tweets.text: I loovee when people text back ... 😒 #sarcastictweet
tweets.notes: Playful spelling of love, delayed reply complaint, unamused emoji, explicit sarcasm hashtag.

tweets.text: Don't you love it when your parents are Pissed because you were gonna study after bubble soccer ! #IKnowIDo #not 😃 🔫
tweets.notes: Classic contrast: love + anger + #not, then a smile and a gun emoji.

tweets.text: I just love having grungy ass hair 😑 #not
tweets.notes: Positive verb, negative evaluation, deadpan emoji, #not.

tweets.text: Anyone in Chem that has to do OWLs knows my pain right now ... #crazycollgelife #not #studying24hrsaday 😩
tweets.notes: Complaint plus #not and a weary face; no genuine praise.

tweets.text: feeling like a million bucks after that chem 2 test . 😅 #not
tweets.notes: Idiom of success flipped by #not and a grimace.

tweets.text: Good thing I spent four years getting MLA formatting shoved down my throat . #itsAPA 😑 👎
tweets.notes: Evaluative 'good thing' plus academic frustration emojis; no #not.

tweets.text: Oh how I love getting home from work at 3am and my house being dirty #not
tweets.notes: Vocative 'oh how I love' plus an unpleasant situation.

tweets.text: <user> i hope youre lurking rn. i want to listen to hallucination & wanna love you again live someday, pretty please?! 😭 😭 😭
tweets.notes: Sincere request. Crying emoji here is emotion, not a sarcasm flip.

tweets.text: <user> Rest in peace & love to you and your family
tweets.notes: Condolence. The word love is literal.

tweets.text: 100 days until Christmas! 🌲 #too soon #not ready yet
tweets.notes: #not is part of '#not ready yet', not a sarcasm marker. Tokenization matters.

tweets.text: 05 really taught me a valuable lesson I'm never gonna be late again! #Not
tweets.notes: Hashtag case-folds to #not but the sentence is a sincere resolution. Cue is noisy.
